## Phase 1 — standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Verdict: `pass`, no findings.

## Adversarial findings — UNAVAILABLE (mandatory second opinion, backend rate-limited)

This is a lights-out run, so the adversarial second opinion is mandatory. The only backend, `openai/fixture-model` (chain[0]), returned HTTP 429 (fixture rate limit), and the chain ran out without an opinion. The review helper turned the rate-limit exhaustion into exit 9 (mandatory chain outage). No human is watching, so the review fails closed and does not pass with a skip. The PR parks until a backend can serve the review.
